item.title: Recording Academy Announces Lifetime Achievement Grammys For Fela Kuti, Paul Simon, Cher, More
item.description: Every year, the Recording Academy hands out a handful of Lifetime Achievement Grammys. Some of the recipients are alive to get the award, and some are not. The Academy has unveiled the list of next year's honorees, and it includes legendary figures like Fela Kuti, Paul Simon, Cher, Chaka Khan, and Whitney Houston.
